name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
title: Welspun Enterprises Ltd - 532553 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 consol revenue +14% to INR1,199 cr and FY26 revenue INR3,615 cr hit guidance, but FY26 revenue fell 2% and FY27 growth guided 15-20% with order book ~INR20,000 cr and no capex discipline signal.

triggers.label: FY27 order inflow INR8,000-10,000 cr
triggers.quote: we expect the order book to be added somewhere around INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores in FY27

triggers.label: EBITDA guide cut to 18% plus
triggers.quote: we are giving a guidance of only 18% plus

triggers.label: Pune-Shirur FY27 revenue INR500-600 cr
triggers.quote: we expect somewhere in the range of, say, INR500 crores to INR600 crores, which will be contributed during this year

guidance.quote: So our guidance will stay to the range of 15%, 20% as we have always maintained and we will continue to maintain.
we are giving a guidance of only 18% plus
we expect the order book to be added somewhere around INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores in FY27
We expect our revenue base to be growing at a rate of 20%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Against our guidance of INR3,600 crores, we delivered revenue of INR3,615 crores
EBITDA margins for the year stood at 23%, exceeding our guided range of 18% to 20%

red_flags.label: EBITDA guidance cut from FY26 level
red_flags.quote: we are giving a guidance of only 18% plus

red_flags.label: Order book depends on large unwon wins
red_flags.quote: we are going to be looking for order booking

evasions.topic: Pune-Shirur FY27 revenue and project IRR detail
evasions.quote: I would request Vaibhav you have interaction with our CFO
saying that we will be able to target it in the next 2 months or 3 months is a matter which I would not want to dwell upon
I would request that if we ne ed to go project by project, so you please get in touch with the IR or CFO
